full.prompt: Fashion lookbook model shot. The model holds the pose with clearly visible natural movement: a gentle weight shift, a slight turn of the torso and head, a soft blink, hands relaxing. The garment keeps its exact shape, color, print and details; the fabric moves naturally. Static locked-off camera, no zoom, no pan. Plain studio background unchanged. Photorealistic.

upper.use: upper body - tops, coats (head to thigh)
upper.prompt: Fashion lookbook upper-body shot. Keep the exact framing: the same upper-body crop, and no more of the body is revealed - do not show the legs or any new clothing below the frame edge. The whole head stays inside the frame. The model moves subtly and naturally: a slight sway of the shoulders, a small turn of the head, a soft blink, relaxed hands. The garment keeps its exact shape, color, print and details; the fabric moves naturally. Static locked-off camera, no zoom, no pan. Plain studio background unchanged. Photorealistic.

lower.use: lower body - skirts, pants (waist to feet)
lower.prompt: Fashion lookbook lower-body shot. Keep the exact framing: the same crop from the waist down - do not reveal the face, the upper body or anything above the top frame edge, and the feet stay inside the frame. The model stays in place without walking: a gentle weight shift from one leg to the other, a small relaxed movement of the hands at the sides. The garment keeps its exact shape, color, print and details; the fabric of the skirt or trousers sways naturally with the movement. Static locked-off camera, no zoom, no pan. Background unchanged. Photorealistic.
